verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents an official `lms` CLI covering terminal chat (`lms chat`), model search and download (`lms get`), model loading with GPU and context-length flags and custom identifiers (`lms load`), and local server control (`lms server start/stop`). The headless llmster daemon extends it to servers and CI, and a community comment praises the headless flow as usable from real tools. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the `lms` CLI itself, and evidence of agent-friendly features such as machine-readable output or scripting docs.
